summary: Defines FLUTE, File Delivery over Unidirectional Transport, a protocol for sending files one way over the Internet, especially suited to multicast networks. It builds on Asynchronous Layered Coding, the base protocol for massively scalable multicast distribution. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Like a radio tower broadcasting a file to many listeners at once, FLUTE sends the same file to everyone without needing each listener to talk back.

questions: how to deliver files over multicast
